author: cens0r3d
install_msg: shazam loaded. Use `[p]shazam` with a file attached, as a reply, or with a media URL, or the `/shazam` slash command. Add `debug` as the last word to see which windows were tried. Run `[p]slash sync` once to publish the slash command.
name: shazam
description: Recognizes songs from uploaded files, from messages you reply to, or from direct media URLs. Tries three windows, reads the raw Shazam payload and answers every failure with a sentence instead of a traceback.
